about: Hand-authored inputs for generate-track-paths.mjs: what the algorithm cannot infer. osm pins the OSM ids to fetch; members of a relation with role "" or "outer" are tag-filtered, ways pinned directly are taken as authored. excludeWays removes ways the walk must never use, each with its reason. startLine is the timing line (where OSM maps start and finish separately, the finish, which is the line a lap is measured across) and the compass heading of travel across it, in degrees clockwise from north, read off the start edge and cross-checked against oneway tagging wherever the way carries it. simplify overrides the defaults per circuit. view.turn (optional: 0, 90 or -90, degrees clockwise) overrides the generator's choice between north up and the quarter turn that draws a tall circuit landscape. sectorLines (two points, or null with a sectorsNote) are the S1/S2 and S2/S3 timing lines, each with its source; the generator projects them onto the ring like the start line and emits their distance fractions.
